description: A neutral life is a calm life #neutrality #PersonalGrowth #SelfMastery
transcript: I live through a lens of neutrality, that space in between judgment and attachment and that allows me to see my life more clear. I have created a portfolio life, different directions, different seasonal changes, different compounds of skills and relationships. For me, change does not feel like loss. I am not afraid to restart and I don't panic when it's time to pivot because I've created this neutral portfolio where I can readjust and survive no matter what the circumstances.
